night_bus, ch1: corner stop → World Cup-ro → Hapjeong stn → Yanghwa-ro stop (~10 min)
walk home, ch1/ch5: mart → laundromat (13 min) → flat (20 min in all)
hapjeong_gate_zone: within 1 km of G1 or G2 (declared ch21)
AREX and Gyeongui–Jungang lines omitted. Banks, roads and bridges simplified; pins good to about 100 m.
